en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an old tavern or inn dining room densely decorated with hunting trophies and rustic ornaments. Antlers, animal heads, horns and various tools hang from the ceiling and walls. A large ornate tiled stove with jugs and plates stands to the left, while wooden benches and carved chairs surround heavy wooden tables set with bottles, glasses, and small decorative pieces. Framed pictures line the patterned wallpaper, and lace trim decorates a wall panel. The overall style is that of a Central European hunting lodge or beer hall.
